title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Drift Under the Moonlight

lines.l: La più grande, la più forte, Italia Dance Music, play your music.
When you appear
Breathing steady
The night is heavy
You pull me closer
I'm losing my measure
And I drift
Into a rhythm I can't define
And I drift
Like a wave that keeps crossing the line
Magic
Your eyes lock and I fall aside
Magic
And I don't wanna break the tie
You're right here, but still on top
Every gesture feels warm and clear
And time slows down when you're near
Breathing steady, the night is heavy
You pull me closer, I'm losing measure
And I drift, into a rhythm I can't define
And I drift, like a wave that keeps crossing the line
And I drift, your eyes lock and I fall inside
And I drift, and I don't want to break the tie
Two small lights in the misty air
Finding each other without a prayer
Only the sound that carries us far
Only the beat that knows who we are
Under the moon, I stay with you
Till the sky
Decides what's true
